description: Source code implementing network link simulation classes (OneWayLink and SymmetricLink) for QUIC protocol testing, including packet handling, delays, and link configuration.

classes.name: OneWayLink
classes.description: Represents a unidirectional network link with packet queuing, delay, and transmission scheduling.

classes.name: SymmetricLink
classes.description: Represents a bidirectional network link composed of two OneWayLinks, connecting two endpoints.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the link, schedules its transmission based on bandwidth and delay.

methods.name: TimeUntilAvailable
methods.description: Returns the time remaining until the link is ready to accept another packet.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Processes the next packet in transit, delivering it to the sink.

methods.name: ScheduleNextPacketDeparture
methods.description: Schedules the departure of the next packet in the queue.

methods.name: GetRandomDelay
methods.description: Calculates a random delay to simulate network noise, bounded to prevent out-of-order delivery.
